basis.governing_question: Which new point-of-sale system should Farmácias Lusas choose, and how can it be rolled out to its 40 pharmacies?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Define the business requirements a new point-of-sale system must meet by assessing how the pharmacies work today.

gate.label: Requirements sign-off
gate.decision: Go ahead with vendor evaluation against these mandatory requirements?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Compare vendors against the requirements, choose one system, and plan its rollout across the 40 pharmacies.

gate.label: Vendor selection
gate.decision: Which system do we select, and go or no-go on its rollout to the pharmacies?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Roll out the chosen point-of-sale system to all 40 pharmacies and prepare their staff to use it.

gate.label: Rollout acceptance
gate.decision: Approve the rollout as complete, with the system running in all 40 pharmacies?

architect_notes: Engagement length is not stated, so 23 to 29 weeks is an estimate built on the archetype's phase lengths and a 40-pharmacy rollout.
The archetype stops at Design; I added Implementation because the brief asks to roll the chosen system out to the pharmacies.
Implementation is the largest estimate: 14 to 16 weeks for 40 pharmacies has no archetype benchmark and needs the client's rollout capacity confirmed.
